name: resq-link
description: Unified workspace runner for ResQ-Link Frontend, Backend, and AI services

scripts.project: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run project:frontend" "npm run project:backend" "npm run project:ai"
scripts.project:ai: cd AI && (if exist .venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe (.venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe app.main:app --reload --port 8000) else (uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000))
scripts.dev:ai: cd AI && (if exist .venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe (.venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe app.main:app --reload --port 8000) else (uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000))
